symptom: alter page/snippet set / insert / replace / drop on a widget inside a legacy table cell reports `widget "X" not found`; field scripts fell back to BSON patches
cause: findInWidgetChildren, findNearestDSInChildren and collectWidgetScopeInChildren walked every other child list but not a Forms$Table's Cells[].Widgets[]
insight: Three walkers must learn every new child list together (the same trio #891 and #1388 each extended); a finder-only fix resolves the target but builds inserted widgets without the cell's data context. Keyed on the `Cells` list, not on $Type: a Mendix 11 cell is Forms$DbTableCell, which gen does not model (widget_list_markers.go), and Forms$Table is the only page type with a Cells list. Not yet run against a Studio Pro-authored table — none exists in testdata and MDL cannot create one; a wrong key guess fails safe as the same not-found
